description: Change a Stripe payment link (plink_…). active:false DEACTIVATES it — its URL then shows a "no longer available" page, in every ad that points at it — and ALWAYS needs confirm:true, test keys included; active:true reactivates it. allowPromotionCodes shows or hides the promotion-code box; afterCompletionUrl (redirect) or afterCompletionMessage (Stripe's confirmation page); inactiveMessage (up to 500 characters, shown while it is off); metadata. Read back. LIVE key: confirm:true after showing the preview. Needs Stripe connected (Connectors > Stripe, or connect_connector).

active.description: false deactivates the link; true reactivates it

afterCompletionMessage.description: message shown on Stripe's confirmation page after paying

afterCompletionUrl.description: URL the buyer is redirected to after paying

allowPromotionCodes.description: true shows the promotion-code box at checkout; false hides it

confirm.description: true to deactivate the link, and to confirm a live-key write

inactiveMessage.description: message shown while the link is off, up to 500 characters

metadata.description: key/value metadata to set on the link

paymentLinkId.description: payment link id, plink_..., from list_stripe_payment_links

name: update_stripe_payment_link
title: update stripe payment link
